description: This file contains schema validation and serialization logic for PyTorch's export serialization, including schema diffing, schema updating, and code generation for schema representations in C++ and Thrift.

classes.name: _Commit
classes.description: Dataclass representing the result of schema update process, including schema content, checksums, and file paths.

methods.name: update_schema
methods.description: Reads existing schema files, computes differences with current schema definitions, and prepares updated schema content and metadata.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs schema version consistency checks and determines if major or minor schema updates are needed based on schema diff.

methods.name: _hash_content
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of a given string content.
